title: Things that must change together when extending apps/dashboard/
answers: What do I need to touch to add a new schema-version migration?
What do I need to touch to add a new dashboard API version?
What do I need to touch to add a new resource kind?
body:
1. New schema migration (e.g. v43): add apps/dashboard/pkg/migration/schemaversion/v43.go, register it in GetMigrations() map (schemaversion/migrations.go:53), AND bump LATEST_VERSION (migrations.go:12). Missing the bump means old dashboards silently stop migrating.
2. New API version (e.g. v3): CUE schema under apps/dashboard/kinds/v3/ → codegen produces apps/dashboard/pkg/apis/dashboard/v3/*_gen.go → conversion functions in apps/dashboard/pkg/migration/conversion/ → in pkg/registry/apis/dashboard/register.go update GetGroupVersions() (:269), InstallSchema() (:280), and add a branch in UpdateAPIGroupInfo/storageForVersion (:1046-:1195). storageForVersion exists specifically so each version persists as itself rather than whatever the scheme reports first (comment at register.go:982-984).
3. New resource kind on an existing version (e.g. Variable/Notebook): must move in lockstep across the admission switch in Validate() (register.go:355, "Reachability invariant" comments at :382/:398) and storage registration (:1160-:1193) — consistency between the two is enforced only by comment, not by the compiler.
applies: Applies specifically to apps/dashboard's versioned-API/migration model; does not generalize to other Grafana apps unless they use the same App SDK versioning pattern.
